title: Cedarville Marine

services.name: Pontoon Rental
services.desc: Cedarville Marine is excited to announce daily pontoon rentals! We have a 2014 16′ Qwest Pontoon, a 2008 21′ Sunset Bay Pontoon, and a 2015 24′ Berkshire. All three are running in great condition. Images below! 2014 16′ Qwest (Red) - 8 person capacity - $350/day 2008 21′ Sunset Bay (Green) - 10 person capacity - $400/day 2015 24′ Berkshire (Black) - 12 person capacity - $500/day We have thoroughly inspected these pontoons ourselves as well as with the DNR & Sheriff’s Department. All pontoons passed their inspections and are ready to be rented! Our team of four technicians is factory certified in both Mercury outboards and Mercruiser

blurb: Cedarville Marine is a full-service marina, maintenance facility, and ship’s store nestled amongst the beautiful Les Cheneaux Islands along Lake Huron’s northern shore. Whether simply passing through on a cruising tour, or seeking a marina operation to fulfill your seasonal needs, we invite you to explore our site further for additional detail on how we may serve
